title: Blue Light becomes Transbluency
summary: Ellington pointed to him mid-recording and the theme he improvised on Blue Light later became Transbluency.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: But several times that extemporaneous playing came about. I distinctly remember one or two numbers that I did that on.
Do you know what numbers they were?
One number was this tune called "Blue Light".
That's the one that later became --
That became "Translucency", and my theme from "Blue Light" was what they used to make the whole number of "Translucency".
And that was one that you had not planned. That was --

That was one that I wrote that number when he pointed to me and said take it. Take a chorus. And from somewhere, I don't know, that melody just came to me as a relief from the -- what the notes and things that had been going on with the rest of the band.
